name: Click ring
description: A soft ring opens at each click in a screen recording, right where the pointer clicked, then fades. The real pointer stays as it was recorded.
when: Screen demos where the viewer should see what you clicked: a button, a menu, a link. Needs a screen take recorded with the cursor log (take-NN-screen.events.json).
needs: a cut that shows a screen take (kind: screen)
the take's cursor log: get_session shows it as events under the screen take
the edit's size and frame.crop, if any
